methodology.codexInstall: Install all 13 skills with skills@1.5.22 --copy into an isolated temporary Git project, then compare every installed SKILL.md byte-for-byte with the current repository; hash the existing global skill files before and after to prove they were not changed
methodology.activation: Requires a recorded task-level run; discovery or installation alone is not activation evidence

codexInstall.note: All 13 current repository SKILL.md files matched the isolated installed copies byte-for-byte. This verifies the recorded project-copy install only; it does not prove activation or future versions.

projectUpdate.note: A controlled historical fixture replaced all 13 project copies while preserving the generated lock file. Project update restored all complete skill folders to the then-current public repository content. This does not verify global updates, lockless installs, activation, or future CLI versions.

existingGlobalCopies.note: The existing global copies were installed before later repository metadata and content updates. Installation is not continuous synchronization; update or reinstall before assuming the local copy matches the current repository.

codexActivation.note: All 13 skills automatically activated in one task. Ten tasks completed in the recorded run, one correctly paused for required user input, and two large tasks initially did not complete before passing smaller bounded retests. This is not evidence for every prompt or client version
